name: Default
description: The set Aiko starts from: story and task pipelines with their statuses, artifacts and per-status instructions, the app point / user point / complete scoring criteria, two board projections and the empty project memory.

criteria.title: App point
criteria.description: How much the product itself needs this work.
criteria.aiInstruction: Judge what this card means to the product itself: correctness, architecture, the cost of not doing it. Score from the requirements and the declared scope, and raise the score when the work explains or removes technical debt.

criteria.title: User point
criteria.description: How much the people using the product need this work.
criteria.aiInstruction: Judge who feels this card and how much: a visible capability, a blocked workflow or a broken result scores high; an internal tidy-up nobody sees scores low.

criteria.title: Complete
criteria.description: How ready the card is: how much of the promised outcome already exists.
criteria.aiInstruction: How much of the promised outcome exists right now. Set it when the card is estimated, and recalculate it after every agent's change so the value describes the card as it is after that work, not as it was before. A card at its last stage tends toward the top of the range.

sizes.title: XS
sizes.description: Under an hour: one file, no analysis, no new dependencies.

sizes.title: S
sizes.description: Half a day or less: a small change that a local test can verify.

sizes.title: M
sizes.description: About a day: a normal task with analysis and implementation.

sizes.title: L
sizes.description: Several days: decompose into subtasks and agree the order before starting.

sizes.title: XL
sizes.description: Over a week: do not start until it is split into S and M tasks.

workflows.title: Stories

stages.title: Backlog
stages.instruction: Clarify the value, the boundaries and the links of this story, and state its requirements on the card. Re-score complete when the picture changes.

stages.title: Elaboration
stages.instruction: Work out the requirements and the architectural constraints of this story and record them in analysis.md. When the analysis is done, re-score app-point and complete with what you learned.

requiredArtifacts.description: The outcome of the story elaboration.

stages.title: Ready for decomposition
stages.instruction: Check that the requirements are unambiguous and that the story can be split into tasks. Re-score complete before moving it on.

stages.title: In progress
stages.instruction: Coordinate the implementation of the child tasks. After every change, re-score complete so the story's score says what it now does.

stages.title: Done
stages.instruction: Verify that the story's outcome was reached and summarize it. Re-score complete to the top of its range before closing the card.

workflows.description: A functional requirement or a user-facing capability, large enough to be decomposed into tasks. Its app-point and user-point say why it matters; its complete score is re-scored after every piece of work.

workflows.title: Tasks

stages.title: Backlog
stages.instruction: Clarify the request, the scope and the links of this task, and state its requirements on the card. Re-score complete when they change.

stages.title: Analysis
stages.instruction: Analyse the task, its risks and the implementation options and record them in analysis.md. When the analysis is done, re-score app-point and complete with what you learned.

requiredArtifacts.description: The outcome of the task analysis.

stages.title: Implementation
stages.instruction: Implement the task and record the files you actually changed. After the change, re-score complete, and re-score app-point when the work altered the technical debt.

requiredArtifacts.description: The outcome of the implementation and its verification.

stages.title: Review
stages.instruction: Check the result, the tests and any deviation from the declared scope. Re-score complete with what is left to do.

stages.title: Done
stages.instruction: Record the outcome of this task and re-score complete to the top of its range before closing the card.

workflows.description: An atomic unit of work an agent carries out within a single stage: one change, one verification. Its complete score is recalculated after each run, so the board shows what is actually done.
